stories.sourceText: Clinic calendar records preserve supplied visits for January 2025 and February 2025, retaining the explicitly sourced original recorded patient scope, measurement units and separately reported values without substituting zero for unavailable observations or publishing extrapolated totals for additional future calendar periods. Clinic visits is 100.00 count during January 2025 among patient visits with denominator 200. Clinic visits is unknown count during February 2025 among patient visits with denominator 200. Clinic visits in January 2025 precedes Clinic visits in February 2025 in calendar order. Clinic visits in January 2025 and Clinic visits in February 2025 remain limited to supplied calendar data.
